svg.title: A full cross-product beside a pairwise covering array
svg.desc: Two columns of rows at the same scale. The left column is the full cross-product of three operating systems, four browsers and three screen sizes, 36 rows tall. The right column is a strength 2 covering array over the same model, 12 rows tall, and the 24 rows it does not run are drawn as an empty block below it. The pair os equals Linux with browser equals Safari is highlighted on both sides: three rows on the left, one row on the right.
svg.text: every pair appears at least once
24 rows the covering array does not run
A third parameter free to take any of its 3 values is what turns one pair into three rows on the left.
Rows are dropped; pairs are not. All 33 pairs the model asks for still appear on the right.
